definitions.full: H1167. baal I. בַּעַל 166 noun masculine owner, lord (Phoenician בעל ; Palmyrene id. husband Vog 62 compare Bae Rel 72 ff. ; Assyrian bêlu 1 with Dl Gram. Glossary ; Arabic husband etc., see especially Nö ZMG 1886, 174 , Sabean בעל CIS iv. 1, 2 ) — Gen 20:3 92t.; suffix בַּעְלִּי Hosea 2:18 ; בַּעְלָּהּ Deut 24:4-5 t.; plural בְּעָלִים Judg 2:11 17 t.; construct בַּעֲלֵי Gen 14:13 27t.; suffix בְּעָלָיו Exod 21:29 14 t.; בְּעָלֶיהָ Job 31:39 2 t.; בַּעְלֵּיהֶן Est 1:17 , 20 ; — I. 1 owner (often plural with suffix in singular meaning): of ox Exod 21:28-29 , (twice in verse); 22:10 ; 22:11 ; 22:13 ; 22:14 (E); ׳ב הבור of pit 21:34 , 36 (E), of house 22:7 (E) Judg 19:22-23 , debt Deut 15:2 , the land Job 31:39 , the ass Isa 1:3 , goods Eccl 5:10 , riches 5:12 ; ׳ב טוב one to whom good is due Prov 3:27 , gain 1:19 ; ׳ב שׂכל one having understanding 16:22 ; ׳ב השׁחד receiver of the gift 17:8 . 2 husband Gen 20:3 ; Exod 21:3 , 22 (E) Deut 22:22 ; 24:4 ; 2Sam 11:26 ; Joel 1:8 ; Prov 12:4 ; 31:11 , 23 , 28 ; Est 1:17 , 20 ; בַּעְלִּי Hosea 2:18 ( my Baal , reference to the divine name used in the northern kingdom, here for the first time forbidden). 3 citizens, inhabitants: בַּעֲלֵי of Jericho Josh 24:11 (E), of the high places of Arnon Num 21:28 (E), of Shechem Judg 9:2 12 t., of the tower of Shechem 9:46-47 , of the city 9:51 , of Gibeah 20:5 , of Keilah 1Sam 23:11-12 , of Jabesh 2Sam 21:12 . 4 rulers, lords: גוֺיִם בַּעֲלֵי Isa 16:8 . 5 n. of relation: a. ׳ב ׃בַּעַל החלמות dreamer Gen 37:19 (E); דברים ׳ב whosoever hath cases, complaints Exod 24:14 (E); ׳ב שׂער an hairy man 2Kin 1:8 ; ׳ב חמה wrathful Nahum 1:2 ; Prov 29:22 ; ׳ב אף one given to anger 22:24 ; ׳ב החכמה one having wisdom Eccl 7:12 ; ׳ב משׁחית destroyer Prov 18:9 ; ׳ב כנף winged thing, bird 1:17 ; Eccl 10:20 ; ׳ב נפשׁ one given to appetite Prov 23:2 ; ׳ב מזמות mischievous person 24:8 ; ׳ב הלשׁון charmer Eccl 10:11 ; ׳ב רשׁע one given to wickedness 8:8 ; ׳ב פיפיות double-edged Isa 41:15 ; ׳ב משׁפט adversary 50:8 ; פקדת ׳ב captain of the ward Jer 37:13 ; ׳ב הקרנים two-horned Dan 8:6 , 20 . b. ׳בּ ׃בַּעֲלֵי בְּדִית confederates Gen 14:13 ; ׳ב חצים archers 49:23 (poetry); ׳ב הפרשׁים horsemen 2Sam 1:6 ; ׳ב שׁבועה conspirators Neh 6:18 ; ׳ב אספות members of assemblies; or well-grouped sayings; or collectors (of wise sentences) Eccl 12:11 . — On 2Sam 6:2 see II. בַּעֲלָה . ( בַּעַל in Hexateuch not J or P; בעל Lev 21:4 ᵐ5 ἐζάπινα = כבלּע Num 4:20 : Di בְּאֵבֶל ). Especially II. lord , specifically as divine name, Baal. 1 without article: בעל במות Num 22:41 (poetry Balaam); פעור בעל 25:3 , 5 (E) Deut 4:3 (see below). This divine name is not used elsewhere in Hexateuch It probably originated from the sense of divine ownership, rather than sovereignty (RS Sem 92 ). It seems to have been used in Northern Israel = אדון in the South. It was the special name of the God of the Canaanites, Philistines, etc., = Babylonian בֵּל , compare Schr SK 1874, 335 ff. In later times scribes substituted בּשֶׁת , in proper name ( ירבשׁת = אשׁבשׁת ירבעל, = אשׁבעל , see בּשֶׁת , Gei ZMG 1862, 728 ff. ), & also in the text for בעל Hosea 9:10 ; Jer 11:13 (hence ἡ βάαλ 2:23 ; 7:9 ; 11:13 , 17 ; 19:5 ; Hosea 2:10 ; 13:1 +, Rom 11:4 , see Di Baal mit d. weib. Art1 Kel, MBA 1881, June 16 Dr 2Sam 4:4 ). 2 with article: הַבַּעַל Judg 2:13 ; 6:25 , 28 , 30 , 31 , 32 ; 1Kin 16:31-32 , (twice in verse); 18:19 , 21 , 22 , 25 , 26 (twice in verse); 18:40 ; 19:18 ; 1 Kings 22:54; 2Kin 3:2 ; 10:18-19 , (twice in verse); 10:20-21 , (3 t. in verse); 10:22-23 , (3 t. in verse); 10:25-26 , 27 (twice in verse); 10:28 ; 11:18 (twice in verse); 17:16 ; 21:3 ; 23:4-5 , 2Chr 23:17 (twice in verse); Jer 2:8 ; 7:9 ; 11:13 , 17 ; 12:16 ; 19:5 (twice in verse); 28:13 ; Jeremiah 28:27; 32:29 ; 32:35 ; Hosea 2:10 ; 13:1 ; Zeph 1:4 . 3 הַבְּעָלִים emphatic plural (compare האדונים האלהים, ) the great lord, the sovereign owner Judg 2:11 ; 3:7 ; 8:33 ; 10:6 , 10 ; 1Sam 7:4 ; 12:10 ; 1Kin 18:18 ; 2Chr 17:3 ; 24:7 ; 28:2 ; 33:3 ; 34:4 ; Jer 2:23 ; 9:13 ; Hosea 2:15 ; 2:19 ; 11:2 (or local special Ba`als, see Dr Sm. p. 50 ; pillars of Baal MV). 4 with attributive: בְּרִית בַּעַל Lord of convenant Judg 8:33 ; 9:4 (compare ברית אל 9:46 ; Nö ZMG 1888, 478 ); ׳ב זְבוּב Lord of flies 2Kin 1:2-3 , 6 , 16 , Philistine god, ᵐ5 Βααλ μυῖαν (Beelzebub, Matt 12:24 ) compare Bae Rel 25 . II. בַּ֫עַל 1. proper name, of a location city in the tribe of Simeon 1Chr 4:33 = בְּאֵר בַּעֲלַת . 2. proper name, masculine a. a Reubenite 1Chr 5:5 ; b. a Gibeonite 1Chr 8:30 ; 9:36 .
